race.description: Kelly Memorial Sponsored By Kellys AGnVET Hcp (Bm52)
race.comment: SUGAR AND SWEET (4) didn't jump the best but really attacked the line to be beaten just half a length when fresh from a spell over 1200m at St Arnaud last start. Kept fresh since that return a month ago. Back in trip but if Yendall can get him to jump cleanly this is a winnable race. GRUMPYOLDCOL (5) went straight to the lead and gave nothing else a chance last time out over 1050m at Wycheproof. Will not find this any harder so with similar tactics likely to be adopted it will take a big effort to run him down. ZAMORA (6) disappointed last start after just failing to lead all the way over 1200m at St Arnaud against a couple of today's key rivals. Ready to peak after three runs back from a break. Veteran mare FROSE (7) wasn't all that far away over this trip at Dunkeld last Saturday. In the mix on the quick turnaround.
